runs.text:
Evanescence and HeadCount, the non-partisan, non-profit voter registration organization, unveiled a public service announcement entitled USE MY VOICE along with a campaign to encourage Americans to check or update their voter registration status.

“Use My Voice” is also the name of the exciting new song by Evanescence off of the band's new album, The Bitter Truth (BMG). Previously released songs and videos “Wasted On You” and “The Game Is Over” have gotten praise from The New York Times, Elle Magazine, Rolling Stone, and more. The band has ignited a new fire for rock fans everywhere. The band’s video for “Wasted on You”, self-shot in March, 2020 while the band was quarantined due to the COVID pandemic, garnered an MTV Video Music Awards nomination in the Best Rock category.
